lines.en: I crawl along the floor of the cave pool.

lines.zh: 我的钳子先探出去，再挪身子。
lines.en: My claws go first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一弹，滑出一段。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I slide a stretch.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一弹，就滑出一段。
lines.en: One flick of my tail carries me along.

lines.zh: 原始洞穴的水里，我很小。
lines.en: In primal cave water I'm tiny.

lines.zh: 我的壳上落着细细的沙。
lines.en: Fine sand settles on my shell.

lines.zh: 我在水草边上转了个弯。
lines.en: I turn at the edge of the weeds.
I move forward little by little.
Mud lifts where I pass.

lines.zh: 我从高一点的石台滑下去。
lines.en: I slide down from a higher ledge.

lines.zh: 我的分节身体一伸一缩。
lines.en: My segmented body stretches and draws in.
I near the shallows slowly.
I lie on the bottom, claws open.
My antennae feel the water.
I wait for something small to swim near.
Bubbles rise from my shell.
The water is cool and clear.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两根柄上。
lines.en: My eyes sit on two stalks.
I sway my tail slowly.
A pebble rolls up beside me.

lines.zh: 两根眼柄从沙里伸出来转。
lines.en: Two eyestalks poke from the sand and turn.
The moonlight underwater is dim.
I count the light patches on the surface.
I move one claw.
A small pool. Just right.

lines.zh: 我夹着一粒沙，松开又夹住。
lines.en: I pinch a grain of sand, release, pinch again.
You've dived; I'm below.
My antennae turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我只有你一根手指那么大。
lines.en: I'm no bigger than one of your fingers.

lines.zh: 我的钳子举起来了，只是防着。
lines.en: My claws are up. Only in defence.
Don't pinch me between two fingers.
I hide on the bottom of your shadow.
The ripples break up your face.
I don't strike first.

lines.zh: 你踩到水底了，泥起来了。
lines.en: You touched bottom and the mud rose.
I back slowly behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我在水底抬头，看着水面。
lines.en: I look up at the surface from below.
You've brought your face to the water.
Half my carapace is shattered.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，我往泥里钻。
lines.en: My shell cracked; I dig into the mud.
I roll onto my side in the water.

lines.zh: 断口在水里漂着，我自己够不着。
lines.en: The broken tip floats away, beyond my reach.

lines.zh: 这一下让我横着滑出去。
lines.en: That sent me sliding sideways.
I work my tail to find my balance.

lines.zh: 我把触角收起来，装成石头。
lines.en: I fold my antennae and play dead stone.
A little color clouds the water.
Your strength surprised me.

lines.zh: 我得往深一点的地方去。
lines.en: I need deeper water.
I can reach those crumbs.
You've let it sink down.
I crawl sideways a little closer.
The scent is faint.
I reach out a small claw.
I snap at nothing.
I taste it; it hasn't gone bad.

lines.zh: 我用钳子夹住碎屑，横着拖。
lines.en: I grip the crumb and drag it sideways.
An inch closer and I can reach.
That's enough for me.
You touch me and I curl my tail.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水把泥冲开。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the water wash the mud away.

lines.zh: 我的钳子碰到你的手指。
lines.en: My claw touches your finger.
Don't push; the water will carry me off.
We collide and the mud swirls.

lines.zh: 我的尾扇被踩住，挣不出来。
lines.en: My tail fan is pinned; I can't pull free.
I go round the other side of the stone.
That flipped me over.
I'm against you, and slippery.
I back into a hollow on the bottom.
Another comes out of the weeds.
Our claws touch.

lines.zh: 它的钳子轻轻碰了碰我的壳。
lines.en: Its pincer taps lightly on my shell.
We lie side by side on the bottom.

lines.zh: 它的触角搭在我的壳上。
lines.en: Its antennae rest on my shell.

lines.zh: 我们一起翻动一小块泥。
lines.en: Together we turn over a patch of mud.

lines.zh: 两只在水里没什么声音。
lines.en: Two of us make little sound.

lines.zh: 这块石头下够我们两个。
lines.en: There's room under this stone for both.
The weeds hide us both.

lines.zh: 这池子里，以后有两只了。
lines.en: There'll be two of us in this pool.

lines.zh: 钳尖夹起一块，刚好入口。
lines.en: My pincer lifts a morsel, just right.
I turn stones on the bottom for scraps.
Too heavy to lift; I drag it.
Something glints in the bottom sand.

lines.zh: 我用两只钳把碎肉扒到嘴边。
lines.en: I rake the meat scraps to my mouth with both pincers.
I dropped it. Too slippery.
Mine. Don't come in after it.
This one smells all right.
I'll hold it and eat later.
I bury it under the sand.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩塌了我的沙窝。
lines.en: Your foot caved in my sandy hollow.
I raise my claws.
I begin to sidle.
This stretch of bottom is mine.
You're nearly against the bottom.
I've kept that blow in mind.
I head for your feet.

lines.zh: 我缩回钳子，往石缝里退。
lines.en: I pull my claws in and back into the crevice.
One pinch and I'm gone.
Don't put your hand down.
Both antennae point at you.
I've turned my body broadside.
I know the crevices on this floor.
You can't back out of this little pool.
I trail you along the bottom.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我横着挪一段。
lines.en: You take a step; I sidle a stretch.
I thread through the crevices.

lines.zh: 水波会把我的位置瞒住。
lines.en: The ripples hide my position.
I wait for you to bend down.
I work my way beneath you.

lines.zh: 我在水底等他弯腰的影子。
lines.en: I wait beneath the water for his bending shadow.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里横着挪出来。
lines.en: I sidle out from the rock crevice.
One more step from you is enough.
I follow the silt you stir up.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕到你的脚后。
lines.en: I work my way behind your feet.
The mud still drifts; you can't see.
I wait in the shallows.
You move, and the water moves.

lines.zh: 我把钳子对准你的脚踝。
lines.en: I aim my claw at your ankle.
I pinch your foot.
That barely broke the skin.
I lunge sideways.
You pull your foot back and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴弹到你的鞋上。
lines.en: My tail flicks against your boot.
Quick, and light.

lines.zh: 我的钳子只夹到你的裤脚。
lines.en: My pincer catches only your trouser cuff.
You've backed onto the shore.
I'm in the water. You can't reach.
I stop. No need for more.

lines.zh: 我夹住你的裤脚，往后拖。
lines.en: I pinch your trouser leg and pull.
Only now do you notice me.
I let go and sidle away.
You lift your foot and water splashes.
The bottom sand stirs.
I sidle out of the crevice.
One more of me in this pool.
My antennae break the surface first.

lines.zh: 一串气泡从水底升上来。
lines.en: A string of bubbles rises.
I settle slowly onto the bottom.
The weeds are thick here.

lines.zh: 我在石头下面安顿下来。
lines.en: I settle beneath a stone.
Moonlight reaches me on the bottom.
I sidle into this water.
I settle on a weed root.
A small shadow joins the bottom.
I move sideways under the water.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头下面出来。
lines.en: I come out from under this stone.
Something moves in the shallows.
I tuck into a shell crevice.
The water heats and I roll over.

lines.zh: 我从石台上摔下来，壳磕了。
lines.en: I fall off the ledge and crack my shell.
This water is too shallow to breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从水底掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts me off the bottom.

lines.zh: 一枚东西擦过我的背甲。
lines.en: Something grazes my back shell.
The spell pins me to the bottom.
There's little to eat in this pool.

lines.zh: 雷沿着水爬过来，我僵住。
lines.en: Lightning crawls through the water and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 水退了，我的壳磕在石上。
lines.en: The water recedes and my shell hits stone.
